newsitem.title: POLAND: Rafako trade suspended due to floods.
newsitem.headline: Rafako trade suspended due to floods.

text.p: The Warsaw bourse has suspended trade in industrial boilermaker Rafako SA from Friday due to the threat to the firm caused by the current flooding in southern Poland, the bourse said in a statement.
"The bourse board is suspending trade in shares of the firm Fabryka Kotlow Rafako SA starting from the bourse session on July 11, 1997," the statement said.
It said the bourse was suspending Rafako "due to...a lack of access to information allowing an appraisal of the influence of the flood on the activity of the firm."
On Thursday the bourse suspended trade in electrode maker ZEW for an indefinite period for the same reason. Both firms are in the southern town of Raciborz which is inundated.
On Friday deputy bourse president Wlodzimierz Magiera told a news conference after the announcement that he did not know how long trade in Rafako would be suspended.
"I can't say exactly until when the quotation of the firm will be suspended. So far we have no confirmation they have been able to enter the grounds of the plant," Magiera said.
"I can't say what will be the bourse decisions on firms in the flooded areas," he added.
Rafako fell 3.6 percent on Wednesday and 3.7 percent on Thursday in moderate trade. ZEW fell 10 percent on Wednesday.
